subject: Next Steps: security questionnaire intake and decision-owner assignments for FinLynx pilot
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Wu <katherine.wu@finlynx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next Steps: security questionnaire intake and decision-owner assignments for FinLynx pilot

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the clear timelines. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) Confirmed decision-makers we heard: Katherine (CPO) as economic buyer, Michael Torres (Head of ML Infra) as technical owner, and procurement (procurement@finlynx.com) will own contract/SLA negotiation. Please correct if I mis-assigned any name.

2) Initial scope (please confirm systems in/out):
   - Production inference API (public endpoint behind VPC egress rules)
   - Preprocessing job writing to FinLynx DW (BigQuery) — read-only ingest
   - SSO via Okta (SAML)
   - Optional nightly snapshot exports to S3 (encrypted)

3) Security questionnaire: you mentioned procurement would send the questionnaire and aim for an internal security review by ~Jan 26. Once we have the questionnaire we'll map owners and provide responses back within ~5 business days.

Action items from Redwood:
- I will consolidate the questionnaire owners and circulate a draft response set (assignments below).
- Attach: redwood-security-snapshot.pdf (high-level architecture + data flow).

Suggested owners (proposed):
- Infra & network/SSO: Karthik Iyer
- Data handling, retention, exports: Marissa Cole
- Contractual/SLA/PSA redline: Ben Carter

Please confirm systems-in-scope and that procurement will share the questionnaire. If procurement prefers, we can take the first pass on answers and return them for review.

Cheers,
Irene

Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene — that matches what we discussed. Procurement is on copy and will lead the questionnaire flow. Forwarding their initial file now (see attachment). High-level timing from our side: procurement review + redlines ~2 weeks, security team to do technical review with answers/back-and-forth by Jan 26.

Decision criteria to flag for your team: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (or ongoing audit schedule)
- Data residency and encryption-at-rest/in-transit
- Access controls and principle of least privilege for cross-team service accounts
- Support SLAs for inference latency and incident response

Attachment: FinLynx_Security_Questionnaire_20260112.xlsx (procurement template).

Michael — would like to schedule a short technical sync next week to walk the infra diagram (Irene, Karthik please join). Procurement — confirm if you also want a PSA draft up front or after questionnaire answers.

Katherine Wu
Chief Product Officer, FinLynx

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: FinLynx questionnaire — owners & draft plan

Team — forwarding FinLynx's questionnaire (attached to prior thread). Proposed plan so we can move quickly: 

1) Owner assignments (confirm or swap):
   - Network, infra, SSO, encryption-in-transit: Karthik
   - Data handling, retention, exports, access controls: Marissa
   - Contractual terms, PSA redline, pricing carve-outs: Ben

2) Timeline:
   - We take a first pass on the questionnaire and return answers by EOD Jan 18 so procurement has something to review.
   - Parallel: Ben to prepare a PSA redline draft by Jan 20 (so procurement sees baseline terms while they review security answers).

3) Clarifying questions for FinLynx to confirm before we answer: 
   - Is the nightly snapshot export required for pilot or optional? (affects retention/residency scope)
   - Any restricted data classes expected in test pilot? (PII, PCI, PHI)
   - Expected traffic profile: peak QPS and average sequence length for latency SLAs

Attachments I will drop into the shared drive: RWD-prep-guide.md (how we answer these questionnaires), a stripped schema of the infra diagram, and the PSA template.

Please mark any sections you want me to handle directly. I will combine edits and send the consolidated draft to Katherine/procurement.

Thanks,
Irene

All good with owners — I will take the PSA redline and the contractual questions. Small asks from my side: 

- Can we loop Legal (Sarah Lee) on the PSA thread once I have a first draft? I expect a few clauses around data processing, liability cap, and termination for convenience to need review.
- Karthik/Marissa: please flag any answers that materially affect commercial terms (eg. persistent data storage >90 days, or snapshot exports to third-party buckets). If so we should surface to procurement early.
- Katherine/FinLynx: would appreciate a short 30-min technical sync with Michael next Wed (Jan 21) if that works — helps us confirm the network egress/ingress patterns.

I'll start the PSA draft this afternoon and drop into the drive.

—Ben
